ITEM 1 | Diced cubes, about 1-1.5 cm, golden-brown with crisp browned edges and some darker caramelized spots, pieces slightly irregular, mixed with a few small green-tinged bits, sitting in a heap on the left side of the plate | 120
ITEM 2 | Soft scrambled egg, pale yellow with lighter curds, moist and loosely clumped, spread in a crumbly low layer under the bacon at the lower left of the plate | 60
ITEM 3 | Cooked bacon strips, reddish-brown with darker browned edges and a glossy, slightly oily sheen, flat layered slices about 0.3 cm thick, overlapping and lying across the egg and potatoes in the center | 45
ITEM 4 | Pineapple chunks, bright yellow with a slightly translucent juicy look, cut into irregular wedges and cubes about 2-3 cm, with a few pieces showing faint darker edges, arranged in a cluster on the right side of the plate | 130
